summary.text: Austin Stubbs is the Republican candidate for Iowa House of Representatives District 45 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Kendra Haug.

Stubbs defeated incumbent Republican Brian Lohse in the June 2026 primary, and says in a Ballotpedia survey that he is running to strengthen parental rights in education and to combat human trafficking.

paragraphs.text: Austin Stubbs graduated from Des Moines Christian High School.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Stubbs said he was born and raised on a farm in Runnells, Iowa, and after college played and then coached professional football in Europe.
He said he has a background in work against human trafficking.
In the survey, Stubbs listed protecting children in the classroom and online, medical freedom and privacy, and parents' authority over their children's education and care among his main messages.
